arjun.khan776@example.com | +91 9435188858

Experienced backend engineer focused on building scalable microservices and resilient platform components using Go and cloud-native tooling. - Built Kafka-backed event processing pipelines for retry and reconciliation flows, and documented operational runbooks in Confluence; tracked and coordinated work via Jira.
